mentions.name: GhostDance
mentions.description: GhostDance is a web app that overlays any uploaded dance video as a translucent ghost on the user's live camera feed so they can follow along and practice in real time. Users upload a video, mirror the ghost dancer, record themselves, and export the recording, all in the mobile browser with no install.
mentions.problem: Learning dance moves from TikTok required an endless pause/rewind loop on a phone.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Built GhostDance — overlay any TikTok dance as a ghost on your camera to practice in real time.

Been learning dance moves from TikTok but hated the pause/rewind loop on my phone. So I built a web app that overlays the original dancer as a translucent ghost directly on your camera feed.
